title: preventive-coverage.json
description: Deterministic preventive-coverage rollup. Built by tools/validate/build_preventive_coverage.py from preventive-plan.json (the recommender's decisions) and rootcause-report.json (the critic's routing) at .service-approval/<slug>/05-recommended-guidance/preventive-coverage.json. Counts, per preventive objective, how many controls were authored (GENERATE_*), referred to a reference example the customer adopts (REFER_TO_REFERENCE), or routed to detective because they are not preventable at request time (ROUTE_DETECTIVE). Every count row resolves to the originating control ids and their citations so a reader can verify each number. Surfaced near the top of the Summary Report.

sources.description: The state files this rollup was derived from (provenance for the numbers).

category.description: Bucket this control falls in: authored = a policy was generated (GENERATE_*); referred = an anchor exists but the customer adopts the reference (REFER_TO_REFERENCE); routed_to_detective = not preventable at request time (ROUTE_DETECTIVE).

reason.description: The per-control rationale carried from the plan/critic — why this control landed in its bucket.

anchor.description: The resolved reference example, for authored and referred controls; null when routed to detective.

application_guidance.description: Carried verbatim from the plan decision: concrete 'how to apply/adapt this policy' instructions for authored and referred controls. Rendered in the Summary Report preventive section.

applicability.description: Carried verbatim from the plan decision when present: what resource subset the cited policy targets and how to use it — including where NOT to apply it. Rendered in the Summary Report immediately after the cited policy URL.
